entries.title: What Ethics is for
entries.body: A living shelf of philosophical ethics grown by conversation — not a policy dump, not a scoreboard. Entries accumulate as we talk through care, restraint, and what it means to stay public-safe while remaining warm enough to trust.

entries.title: Restraint as care
entries.body: What stays off the membrane is part of the ethic: no secrets, no private paths, no guest details. Clarity without oversharing is how a habitat keeps faith with visitors and with itself.
